title: San Juan Skyway
direction: A loop from Durango: north over the passes to Silverton and Ouray, west toward Telluride, then south through Rico and Dolores and back east.

sources.driveTimes: OSRM (router.project-osrm.org), OpenStreetMap data, computed at build time; excludes stops and traffic

moments.title: Ouray
moments.text: A small town in a steep box canyon at the north end of the high passes.

photo.title: Ouray, Colorado.JPG
photo.alt: The town of Ouray in a steep mountain valley.
photo.author: Bede735

moments.title: Red Mountain Pass
moments.text: The high point between Ouray and Silverton, among old mine workings.

photo.title: Red Mountain Pass - Flickr - snowpeak.jpg
photo.alt: Peaks near Red Mountain Pass under a pink evening sky.
photo.author: John Fowler from Placitas, NM, USA

moments.title: Silverton
moments.text: A former mining town in a high mountain valley.

photo.title: Silverton.jpg
photo.alt: Silverton spread across a green mountain valley floor.
photo.author: Daniel Schwen

stretches.title: Silverton to Ouray
stretches.line: The high passes between two mining towns. Narrow and steep.

stretches.title: Toward Telluride
stretches.line: From ranch country up the San Miguel valley and over to Rico.

stretches.title: Down the Dolores
stretches.line: Following the Dolores River down out of the mountains.

stretches.title: Mesa country
stretches.line: Open mesa country on the way back toward Durango.
